import re
from pathlib import Path
base=Path("/workspace/scratch/eeae3ae186b3/interno-study/experiments/unattended-optimization-v3/campaigns/campaign-2/development/operations")
profiles=[
("small-build","10fc8ed3f487438986d826c530020033"),
("sparse-narrow","09a8c05cc3fd42949598fc69baa2c2e2"),
("dense-wide","75b1319aec674f929b01ba0d2a2f1e2a"),
("global-mixed","f095f73261104b5393bee1f10bc190a5"),
("skewed","7383f3839d4c4bdb9afd763d2c35a0aa"),
("high-cardinality","740b0e1eefc14a289e605dd93fdc5d6b"),
]
row_re=re.compile(r"^\s*([\d,]+)\s+\(\s*([\d.]+%)\)\s+(.*)$")
for name,op in profiles:
    text=(base/op/"annotation-01"/"stdout.txt").read_text()
    total=re.search(r"([\d,]+\s+\(100\.0%\)\s+PROGRAM TOTALS)",text)
    rows=[]
    for line in text.splitlines():
        m=row_re.match(line)
        if m and m.group(3)!="PROGRAM TOTALS":
            rows.append((int(m.group(1).replace(",","")),m.group(2),m.group(3)))
    print(f"{name}: total={total.group(1) if total else 'missing'}")
    for n,pct,symbol in rows[:5]:
        print(f"  {n:,} ({pct}) {symbol}")
PY
